items: 3 chicken breasts, cut in half then sliced again
½ tsp each sage, rosemary, and thyme

steps.title: Make the herb butter
steps.body: Mix **2 Tbsp dried parsley** and **½ tsp each sage, rosemary, and thyme** with **½ cup butter**, melted.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.body: Dip chicken pieces (**3 chicken breasts**, cut in half then sliced again) in **1 egg**, then flour, then **1 cup bread crumbs**.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Place a slice of mozzarella (**6 slices mozzarella**) between 2 pieces of chicken.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour butter over chicken. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
